info.name: Lineup
info.summary: Plan trainings, events and attendance for your club, right inside Nextcloud with single sign-on.
info.description:
**Lineup** is a hosted planning tool for clubs and teams, for example rowing clubs: members sign up for trainings and events, coaches see who is coming, plan training groups and keep track of attendance and absences.
This app embeds Lineup in your Nextcloud and signs your Nextcloud users in automatically. No second password: Nextcloud hands a short-lived, signed token to Lineup, and users are matched by their email address.
### Requirements
- A free account and organization on [lineup.insidertips.ch](https://lineup.insidertips.ch). - Every Nextcloud user who should use Lineup needs an email address in Nextcloud.
### Connect
1. In Lineup, open your organization and create a **Nextcloud connection**. Lineup shows a connection code (`lnc1.…`). 2. In Nextcloud, open **Administration settings > Lineup**, paste the code and click **Connect**. 3. Lineup now appears in the Nextcloud app menu for all users.
The shared secret contained in the code is stored server-side only and never sent to the browser.
info.author: Pascal Berger
